name: Takami Akitoshi
source:
Akitoshi is first-year high school student who lives alone with his beautiful elder sister Hitomi since the death of his parents.
To avoid his own death he is forced to conceive a child with some girl within a week. And since he has crush on his sister, she is the first that he request.
